name: Codestral
short: Mistral AI's open-weight 22B code model for low-latency code completion, inline fill-in-the-middle (FIM), and developer tool assistance.
modalities: Text and code in; text and code out
pricingNote: $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M input/output tokens ($0.03 cached input; Mistral AI)
standout: Mistral's first open-weight code model, purpose-built for low-latency autocomplete and fill-in-the-middle completion.
tradeoff: A 22B dense model whose 32K native window trails frontier 256K+ context standards.
